prompt: A main agent needs one fact buried in a 500-page manual. Searching it would fill the main context with irrelevant pages.
tells: one fact buried in a 500-page manual
why: Send a sub-agent with its own window to search; it returns just the fact.
trap: Just-in-time loading still lands the noise in the main window.

prompt: Three areas of a codebase must be investigated, and each investigation reads dozens of files.
tells: each investigation reads dozens of files
why: Run each in a sub-agent with a fresh window; collect condensed findings.
trap: The win is clean context, not only speed.

prompt: A code reviewer agent is more objective when it hasn't seen the author agent's reasoning, only the diff.
tells: hasn't seen the author agent's reasoning
why: A separate window avoids inheriting the author's assumptions.
trap: Separation helps judgment, not just size.

prompt: Sub-agents return 20-page transcripts to the orchestrator, flooding its context.
why: Have sub-agents return short, structured summaries; that's the point of isolating them.
trap: Isolation fails if the noise comes right back.
